title: refactor(objectql): move the write-path reference check and the caller's master-detail header read out of engine.ts into engine-referential-integrity.ts (#25522 cut 10)

Cut 10 of the `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6423785652`. Two bodies of the "Referential integrity and master-detail resolution" section move unedited into a new module, `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts`: `assertReferencesResolve` (the write path's #4441 reference check) and `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` (#22519, which master-detail headers the caller's read door returns). The module helper `isEmptyReferenceValue`, which only the first calls, moves with them. No behaviour changes. #25522 stays open for the later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-oed4lq` (the card thread's harness-pinned branch), cut from `origin/main` at `366e4aa69`, which is cut 9's merge (#26263). Nothing was edited before that merge landed.

The full per-method screen and both price lists are in the project file `pm-orders/server/25522-cut10-seam-table.md`. The stay rules are cut 9's (inferred-return public, a U site, a private-static read, an `objectql/src/engine.ts#NAME` pointer under `packages/spec/**` or `docs/adr/**`, an engine self-call, a static), plus two new ones:

- **Erasure.** A body holding a `query-options/no-any-erasure` site stays. `scripts/query-options-erasure-baseline.json` is shrink-only in its key set ("adding a file here is not a sanctioned move"), so a new module cannot carry one. Linting `engine.ts` under an ungrandfathered file name finds the baseline's 8 sites, in `seedAutonumber`, `referenceExists`, `resolveMasterDetailParent`, `resolveMasterDetailParents`, `inspectDanglingReferences`, `find`, `findOne` and `probeReferencingRows`.
- **Module-helper closure.** A body calling a non-exported top-level helper of `engine.ts` moves only when every user of that helper (and of that helper's own helpers) moves too. Otherwise the module would value-import `engine.ts`, a cycle at run time.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Referential integrity** (this PR) | `assertReferencesResolve` 79, `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` 23, helper `isEmptyReferenceValue` | **29 of 102** body lines | **-98 measured** | the coldest area that pays |
| Autonumber (cut 9's proposal, about -75) | `isIssuedAutonumberCollision` 5, `warnAutonumberReadersUnserved` 13 | 15 of 18 | about -5 | does not pay. `seedAutonumber` holds an erasure site; `adoptExplicitAutonumber` shares `readStoredAutonumberCounter` with it, and spec prose (`packages/spec/src/data/autonumber-format.ts`) names that helper in `engine.ts`, which this claim may not edit |
| File-reference hydration | 5 bodies, 288 lines, helpers local | 176 of 288 | about -243 | pays most, but 61% of its lines are from the last 30 days |
| Driver options and engine posture | 6 bodies with `accessibleOrganizationsOf` | about 84 of 146 | about -120 | hot |
| Migration flags and attestations | 8 bodies | 50 of 154 | about -91 | the section writes fields, so its host needs setters (a seat ruling first) |
| Readable-ids, Package registration, count, Delete cascade, Query lowering and the rest | - | - | -87 to 0 | hot, or blocked by a shared helper, or pays little |

In Referential integrity the rest stays: `referenceExists`, `resolveMasterDetailParent` and `resolveMasterDetailParents` read the private static `referenceCheckContext` and hold erasure sites; `settleMasterDetailLanding` calls `staticReadonlyStripTakes`, whose `staticReadonlyStoredView` `update` also uses; `resolvePreviewParents` (`masterIdOf`, `servedAsStored`) and `resolvePredicateRelated` / `resolveOneHopRelated` (`undeclaredRelatedFields`) share helpers with bodies that stay; `masterDetailHeaderExists`, `materializeParentHeader` and `masterDeclaredFields` are no longer than their stubs would be.

## The shape

- The class keeps both methods with name, modifiers (`private async`), signature, docblock and position. Each body is now one host literal of exactly the `ReferentialIntegrityHost` members it reads, plus a `.call`, marked `[#25522 cut 10]`, as cut 8's stubs are: `assertReferencesResolve` gets `masterDetailHeaderExists` and `referenceExists` as late-bound closures; `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` gets `find` as a closure and `logger` as a getter.
- **One named host.** `ReferentialIntegrityHost` types each member as the class member (`ObjectQL['find']` and so on); each function's `this` is the `Pick` of what it reads. The module imports the engine only as a type.
- **The helper.** `isEmptyReferenceValue` moves with its docblock byte for byte (508 bytes, 12 lines) and is not exported; its only user was `assertReferencesResolve`. One copy, no re-derivation.
- **Imports.** The module imports `referenceTargetOf` and `EngineQueryOptions` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), `ExecutionContext` (type), and `ValidationError` and `buildFieldError` (`./validation/record-validator.js`), the bindings `engine.ts` used. `engine.ts` drops `buildFieldError` from its import (its last reader moved; `tsc` reported TS6133) and gains the new module import with a three-line comment.
- The module header names what moved, what stays and why. It cites no ADR.

## Net lines (the seat's rule)

`engine.ts` goes from 23,040 to 22,942 lines, **net -98** (18 added, 116 removed). The module is 200 lines. With the two re-keyed census rows and the one re-keyed readers row, the diff is 340 changed lines over 4 files (+221 / -119).

## Proof of move-only

A TypeScript-AST leaf-token compare (`pm-orders/server/evidence/25522/astcmp.mjs`, unchanged from cut 9) of base `engine.ts` (`366e4aa69`) against the head module:

- Both bodies are **SAME** in parameters, return type, type parameters, body tokens and `async`, and every body line equals the base line less two leading spaces, comments included: `assertReferencesResolve` 285 tokens / 79 lines, `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` 239 / 23.
- `isEmptyReferenceValue`: the base text from its docblock to its closing brace is a substring of the module, and `engine.ts` no longer declares it.
- Class: 318 members at both ends, in the same order. 316 are byte-identical, and the 2 stubs keep docblock, modifiers and signature byte-identical up to the body.
- Top level: 229 of 233 base statements are byte-identical in head. The other four: the class; the `record-validator.js` import, less `buildFieldError`; `isEmptyReferenceValue`, moved; and `masterIdOf`, whose own text and docblock are identical (`getText` equal) but whose leading trivia now starts with the `implements IObjectQLEngine` comment that used to sit above `isEmptyReferenceValue`'s docblock. That comment describes the class, so it stays in `engine.ts` unedited. Head adds the new module import with its comment.

Restored from `HEAD`, blob hash compared, green again.
- **The federated injected-column readers table (migrated in this PR).** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys rows by `FILE#FUNCTION :: SEAM`, and `assertReferencesResolve` calls `referenceTargetOf`, so its row is re-keyed `engine-referential-integrity.ts#assertReferencesResolve :: referenceTargetOf()`; disposition and reason unchanged. Head: 5 of 5 pass. **Control:** the base file over this head fails 1 of 5 and names the new key; restored, blob hash compared.
- **ADR anchors.** No `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry describes a moved body (the engine entry's one paragraph is the transaction seam). The moved bodies cite no decision letter, and the docblocks that cite ADR-0131 D1 and ADR-0055 stay on the methods. `check-adr-anchors` at base `366e4aa69` (clean detached worktree): 90 anchored files, **1,880** decision-letter citations, 59,261 resolving citations; at head: 90, **1,880**, 59,261.

Prose that names the methods (`service-messaging` and `service-settings` `actor-reference.ts`, `plugin-security` `position-catalog-refusal.ts`, test comments) still resolves, because both methods stay on the class.
- No gate baseline keys a moved body (`durability-read-invention.baseline.json` keys only `referenceExists`, which stays; `query-options-erasure-baseline.json` keeps `engine.ts` at 8, since `masterDetailHeadersCallerReads` spells `as EngineQueryOptions`).

## Acceptance notes

- Serial check, re-read before `pr_create`: no open PR touches `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `system-context.mdx` or `scripts/adr-anchors/`. #26138 edits `validation/rule-validator.test.ts` only. `origin/main` moved 10 commits after the base, none on `packages/objectql/**`, `content/docs/permissions/**`, `scripts/adr-anchors/**` or the readers test, so the branch was not merged again.
- **Cut 9's proposal does not pay.** Autonumber, priced about -75 without the erasure and helper screens, pays about -5 under them (table above). The seam script now in the project files carries both screens.
- Next cut from this screen: File-reference hydration (about -243, all five bodies and their three helpers local, 61% recent lines), or Driver options (about -120, `driverWriteTarget` moves with `engineLayer0Verdict` so `accessibleOrganizationsOf` stays module-local). Migration flags still needs a setter ruling.

- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 90 families on the real diff. Every one was run, each exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: 90 accounted for, 88 run green, 2 **NOT MEASURED** (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET; CI runs both): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs every package's `dist/`) and `@objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` (needs the full build). Three first-run exit codes were prerequisites, re-run green after meeting them: `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` (shallow clone; deepened to 2026-07-21, 97.6%), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (needed the objectql `dist/`). Named readings: `check-system-context-census` OK, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:org-identifier`, `check:logger-receiver-detach`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check-affected-docs` exit 0.
- Hand gates outside the derivation, all exit 0 at `b1f3252c8`: `check-adr-anchors` at base and head (above), `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` and `check-commit-card-trailers --range origin/main..HEAD`.

`skip-changeset`: move-only. The published `.d.ts` files are byte-identical, `liveness/` and every other published path are untouched, and the module's runtime is the same code under a different file name. The docs edit changes only the anchor path in two rows of the census table.
